WHY CHOOSE TEMPERED GLASS SCREEN PROTECTOR FOR YOUR CAR?
1.In daily use,collisions are indispensable,which may damage or scratch your 2025 2026 Tiguan SEL R-Line 15 Inch screen,and the maintenance cost of the 2025 2026 Tiguan SEL R-Line screen is quite high.
2.Tempered glass screen protector can defend your 2025 2026 Tiguan 15 Inch screen from oil or other dirty things,reduce your eye's fatigue.
3.Tempered glass screen protector can always keep your 2025 2026 Tiguan center screen brand-new.

Why do you choose SKTU 2025 2026 Tiguan SEL R-Line 15-Inch Glass Screen Protector?
1.0.26mm ultra thin,original color HD clear,touch sensitive,and feel as smooth as the original 2025 2026 Tiguan SEL R-Line screen.
2.9H high hardness can ensure scratch resistant,effectively resist the collision of hard objects and friction,more anti-scratch performance.
3.2.5d arc edge,rounded edge design give you smooth touch feeling,reduce the probability of broken screen.
4.Oleophobic layer protect your 2025 2026 Tiguan SEL R-Line screen away from oil and water,keeps the 2025 2026 Tiguan screen brand new.
5.Easy installation,the 2025 2026 Tiguan SEL R-Line screen protector comes with automatic adsorption features when install it,just clean the 2025 2026 Tiguan screen and align the 2025 2026 Tiguan SEL R-Line screen protector before it and tear it off.

Nice Choice
1.We strictly control every production link,From choose material to make the 2025 2026 Tiguan 15 Inch glass screen protector,No errors are allowed.
2.We use the premium quality of glass and the glue to ensure the 2025 2026 Tiguan SEL R-Line 15 Inch screen protector's quality.
3.We always put first the customer's satisfaction,try our best to solve customer's any problem.

Package includes

Notes:
